name: sapling-grow
comment: BlockSapling (BlockSapling.java:12-55) and the tree generators (WorldGenTrees, WorldGenBigTree, WorldGenTaiga2, WorldGenForest): bands of oak, spruce and birch saplings (meta 8, 9, 10: the ready bit already set, so one success grows them; one oak row at meta 0 must set it first) fill a dirt platform over four chunks, so the 80 random ticks per chunk reach saplings often enough. A sapling in light 9 succeeds one time in 30: it sets the ready bit (8), or grows: Taiga2 for spruce, Forest for birch, Trees or one time in ten BigTree for oak (growTree; no biome is asked). A tree that does not fit (a neighbour's trunk in its crown space) puts the sapling back without the ready bit. chunk_digest of the four chunks every 100 ticks (blocks, metadata, light), rng_state every tick, block_box of the whole tree volume at the end.
